title: [GMCP 203.019.05] Interoperability and quality: Human consent, approvals, and interaction UX
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-019-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: Every consequential MCP action has a consistent inspect-before-run experience showing server identity, exact tool and arguments, data leaving the machine, credentials and side effects, with session and durable consent scoped separately. Approval is revocable, non-transferable and inaccessible to untrusted content; headless denial, accessibility, batching, timeout and emergency-stop behavior are all deterministic and audited. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
